faceCard.costume: Muted dark CINNABAR-SCARLET Song round-collar public official robe, plain pale inner collar, NO square rank patch or necklace. Black SONG STRAIGHT-FOOT FUTOU: compact soft-black central cap with TWO EXTREMELY LONG NARROW RIGID STRAIGHT BLACK BARS extending HORIZONTALLY to BOTH SIDES. Bars are thin rectangular rods, thickness0.8% of canvas height; total implied width far BEYOND shoulders and canvas. Show straight bars continuously from cap to both frame edges; their far ends are INTENTIONALLY CROPPED. No oval paddles, no soft hanging fabric, no bending or short Ming wings.

faceCard.costume: SONG EMPRESS: broad OPEN LIGHT BRANCH-LIKE DRAGON-PHOENIX FLOWER-HAIRPIN ceremonial CROWN, five simple golden flower clusters, two stylized GOLD PHOENIX BIRD silhouettes and one small DRAGON outline on open stems. Entire crown fits from top12% to roughly26% height; low compact hair underneath, NEVER a tall Tang stacked bun. Crown visibly MUCH broader and grander than ordinary small flower cap, but keep graphic SIMPLE. WHITE PEARL FACE MAKEUP is mandatory: 3–5 clearly visible small round white pearls on FOREHEAD and a small GROUP OF THREE on EACH CHEEK near outer eye/temple. Pearls are rounded white dots with thin pale-ink outline, NOT freckles, red flowers or gold face paint. This is Song empress portrait iconography. Muted deep INDIGO-BLUE Song ceremonial outer robe, neat pale inner collar, covered modest chest, a few simple gold trim lines only. NO Qing dianzi, no Ming domed phoenix helmet, no dangling pearl face curtain, no Tang red huadian or low-cut ruqun/pibo.
